name: Iowa
sources: Flat rate 3.8% for 2026: Iowa Department of Revenue press release, Oct 21, 2025 (revenue.iowa.gov/press-release/2025-10-21/idr-announces-2026-individual-income-tax-and-interest-rates); Senate File 2442 (2024)
Starting point federal taxable income with rolling IRC conformity: IA 1040 Expanded Instructions 2025, 'Conformity with the IRC'
Exemption credits ($40 per personal and dependent credit, $20 per person 65+ or blind): IA 1040 Expanded Instructions 2025, 'Exemption Credits'
School district surtax as a percentage of tax: IA 1040 Expanded Instructions 2025, 'School District Surtax/Emergency'; rates: IDR form 41-027 (2025)
provisional: Exemption credit amounts ($40 and $20) are from the 2025 IA 1040 instructions; 2026 instructions not yet published
notes: Iowa's school district surtax (0–20% of Iowa tax, set by your district; 0% in Des Moines and Davenport, 5% in Cedar Rapids) is not included.
